Title: Comparative Analysis of the PIN Auxin Transporter Gene Family in Different Plant Species: A Focus on Structural and Expression Profiling of PINs in Solanum tuberosum
Abstract: @GENE_PIN6 @GENE_844046 @@@PIN6@@@, one of the <m>PIN</m> family members of @CHEMICAL_Indoleacetic_Acids @CHEMICAL_MESH:D007210 @@@<m>auxin</m>@@@ efflux carriers in @SPECIES_3702 @@@Arabidopsis@@@, was reported to differ from the defined 'PM' and 'ER' <m>PINs</m> or 'canonical' and 'noncanonical' <m>PINs</m> for it had localizations to the <m>plasma</m> <m>membrane</m>, as well as endoplasmic reticulum.
